commands.detail: Shared route policy matrix, shell contract, scoped oxlint, and git diff check passed.

implementation: Extracted pure session shell/default-route and pathname outcome policy into mediaStudioRoutePolicy.ts.
MediaStudioApp consumes the imported policy; route QA invokes the same production policy and outcome functions.
Personal and admin shell outcomes are explicit full navigation; organization is the only compact outcome, with the item-count threshold retained.
Workspace fallback action is required and explicitly null at every call site, preventing SurfaceState permission defaults from adding login.
remaining_risks: No browser interaction or rendered responsive/authenticated runtime proof was run in this bounded lane.
Oxlint reports two existing react/only-export-components warnings for exported navigation constants; no lint errors occurred.
